text: 4.14 Application and On-line Inter-Ministerial Consultations for fixation of norms/adhoc norms (i) Application filed online by the applicant shall be forwarded electronically to the concerned Technical / Administrative Ministry / Department /Scientific and Technological institutions or any other agency by the respective Norms Committee in the DGFT headquarters within three days. (ii) The concerned Technical / Administrative Ministry / Department / Scientific and Technological institutions or any other agency as the case may be, may communicate its views / comments / recommendations within 45 days electronically/online. In case no comments are received within 90 days, Norms Committee may take a view based on the facts available on record. (iii) Ad-hoc Input Output Norms may also be decided in a rule based IT environment without reference to Norms Committee. However, a certain percentage of cases as flagged by the RMS may be referred to Norms Committee for validation / review.vi 4.14 Application and On-line Inter-Ministerial Consultations for fixation of norms/adhoc norms (i) Application filed online by the applicant shall be forwarded electronically to the concerned Technical / Administrative Ministry / Department /Scientific and Technological institutions or any other agency by the respective Norms Committee in the DGFT headquarters within three days.
